Proposal (short summary):
1) Minimal shift (preferred): +10 business days to acceptance window. Keep go-live target as a hard window but activate staggered roll (canary 5% traffic -> 25% -> 100%) to reduce business impact.
2) Conservative shift: +15 business days + extended acceptance period and a 30-day post-go-live remediation window.

Mitigations we can offer:
- $10k credit escrow tied to acceptance delay milestones (Ben, is finance/legal ok?)
- Dedicated Redwood engineering on-call during acceptance and first 7 days post-go-live (Aditya to confirm resource model)
- Optional limited-scope canary (only specific API routes) so OliveHealth can start partial traffic earlier if procurement allows subset access

Action items I need fast:
- Ben: quick sign-off on credit escrow and wording for the invoice holdback (I attached ProcurementChecklist.pdf).
- Aditya: confirm if we can commit to canary engineering support for the dates below.
- Emily: confirm whether the steering committee would accept a staggered canary + escrow approach or if they need a single firm date.

I'll be available on Slack and can join the 7/5 steering call if helpful.

Subject: Proposed MAP v3 (compressed QA lane + closure shield)

Emily — attached is MAP_v3.xlsx (finalized for steering). High-level summary of what we recommend the committee approve tomorrow: 

1) Compressed QA lane (Minimal shift): +10 business days to the acceptance start date. To reclaim velocity we propose a focused QA scope limited to critical acceptance tests (security smoke, end-to-end happy path, and data residency verification).

2) Canary go-live option: allow OliveHealth to route 5% production traffic to a scoped feature set once the compressed QA lane passes. Full roll contingent on acceptance sign-off.

3) Closure shield (commercial mitigation): $10k credit escrow tied to acceptance milestones. Language will be time-boxed; Ben will provide the finance wording and Legal will issue the final clause if needed.

4) Ops support: Redwood will provide dedicated on-call engineering for acceptance + 7 days post full roll. Aditya: proposed support dates 2028-07-25 -> 2028-08-02 (if minimal shift accepted).

Why this path: it reduces executive risk by offering a visible mitigation (canary + escrow) while keeping the go-live runway as tight as possible. If procurement requires a conservative approach we can move to the +15 business day plan included in the sheet.

Please see the attached worksheet for the exact milestone timestamps and test definitions. Can you confirm whether the steering committee will accept the canary + escrow combination tomorrow? If yes we will finalize the holdback language and share the DocuSign link before the end of day.

Best,
Grace
